summary: The machine-learning test suite now covers text generation through both inference paths, including concurrency, cancellation, and generator abandonment. It also adds smoke tests for autofill and smart window intent models, and shared end-to-end performance tools that track engine activity and measure runs without tearing down engines before warm-up samples. The suite was also cleaned up to make ONNX backend selection and availability more consistent and to remove unused security-layer plumbing.
